title: Assumption of independent query/key components for scaling
description: The scaling factor for dot-product attention is justified by assuming query and key components are independent random variables with mean 0 and variance 1, which is a simplifying assumption about the input representations.
canonical_description: assumption that query and key components are independent random variables with zero mean and unit variance

evidence.quote: assume that the components of q and k are independent random variables with mean 0 and variance 1
